annotations.title: Show a photo book and its price

description: Use this to show a book that was already made, or to get its price for one copy including shipping when country is supplied. Needs the book's private bookToken. Photos, cover, title, layout and materials are changed in the foto foto editor.

language.description: Two-letter code of the language the person writes in, such as nl or en.

name: get_book

claimUrl.description: Private link where the person saves the book with their email, then edits and orders it.

language.description: The chat's language, as passed in.

materials.description: Binding, cover and paper the book is priced with, e.g. "Layflat binding · Linen cover · Fine art paper"; null without a country.

orderable.description: Whether the book can be printed as it is.

price.description: One copy including shipping, when country was given and the book can be ordered.

unavailableReason.description: Why it cannot be printed yet, such as too few pages.
